dex.text: A big black dog with eyes like two lit lamps, seen on the cliff path at Bouley Bay after dark. It does not bite. It walks beside you the whole way home and never once looks round, and that is worse.
dex.fact: Tchian is Jerriais for dog. A ghostly black dog is said to haunt Bouley Bay on Jersey's north coast, and the Black Dog of Bouley Bay is one of the island's best-known legends.
